classification.difficultyReason: Determine the financed balance, derive the monthly repayment using a geometric series, and include the deposit in the total cost.

content.prompt: Danny buys a home cinema system for $\$10\,000$. He pays a $\$1500$ deposit and borrows the balance at 18% p.a. over 4 years, compounded monthly.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the amount of each monthly repayment to the nearest cent.

answer.worked:
Loan amount:
$$\begin{aligned}P&=10000-1500\\P&=8500\end{aligned}$$
Monthly growth factor:
$$r=1+\frac{0.18}{12}=1.015$$
Number of repayments:
$$n=4\times12=48$$
Let $M$ be the monthly repayment.

Start: $8500$.

After the first repayment: $8500r-M$.

After the second repayment:
$$\begin{aligned}(8500r-M)r-M&=8500r^2-Mr-M\end{aligned}$$
After the 48th repayment:
$$8500r^{48}-Mr^{47}-\cdots-M$$
The repayment terms form a geometric series with first term $M$, common ratio $r$ and 48 terms. When the loan is repaid:
$$\begin{aligned}0&=8500r^{48}-M\frac{r^{48}-1}{r-1}\\M\frac{r^{48}-1}{r-1}&=8500r^{48}\\M&=\frac{8500r^{48}(r-1)}{r^{48}-1}\\M&=\frac{8500(1.015)^{48}(0.015)}{(1.015)^{48}-1}\\M&\approx\$249.69\end{aligned}$$
The monthly repayment is $\$249.69$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: How much did Danny pay altogether? Use your rounded repayment from part (a).

answer.worked:
Include the deposit and all 48 monthly repayments:
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Total paid}&=1500+48(249.69)\\\text{Total paid}&=\$13\,485.12\end{aligned}$$
